A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 27-page RestoreGrad paper, including Appendices A–D. Text, equations, tables, and figures support complete comparison. Rendered pages 2–27 are identical; page 1 differs only in the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D report original RestoreGrad experiments on speech enhancement, image restoration, generalization, ASR, deblurring, and super-resolution.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain the same original experimental results for RestoreGrad, including quantitative comparisons and qualitative restoration examples.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix C.1 retain identical prior/posterior encoders, loss functions, joint training procedure, and sampling algorithms.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage is identical, including speech enhancement and ASR, adverse-weather restoration, CHiME-3 and realistic-image evaluation, RealBlur deblurring, and DIV2K ×2/×4 super-resolution.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including CDiffuSE and PriorGrad for speech, WeatherDiff and TransWeather for multi-weather restoration, and the additional Appendix D comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain the same data splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and inference schedules. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The posterior-network ablation, encoder-size comparison, sampling-step robustness tests, regularization sensitivity analyses, generalization tests, and qualitative case studies are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over 10 independent samplings for Tables 1 and 10. Run-count, seed, and uncertainty-reporting information is unchanged.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–13 and all plotted and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, RestoreGrad's six-step PESQ remains 2.51 in Table 1, and its RainDrop PSNR remains 32.69 in Table 10.

T1.justification: Propositions 3.1 and 3.2, their assumptions, and the proof and derivation in Appendices A and B are identical. No mathematical reasoning or definitions are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about jointly learned priors, restoration quality, faster training convergence, and reduced sampling requirements.

C2.justification: Interpretations of learned priors, regularization, generalization, and performance tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 6 retains the limitation to signal restoration with zero-mean Gaussian priors whose covariance is learned.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, and code/data access information in Section 4 and Appendix C are identical.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and research positioning are unchanged, including the relationship to PriorGrad and the diffusion-efficiency and signal-restoration literature in Section 5.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1, 19 Feb 2025, to v2, 1 May 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–19, Tables 1–13, captions, and their placement are identical. The version/date text update does not alter the document layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific content and presentation, including all appendix evidence, are unchanged. Updating the administrative version/date stamp provides no meaningful improvement or deterioration in the paper's overall quality.
